query: Vince Phillips held a junior welterweight title by an organization recognized by what larger Hall of Fame?

repl_history.response:
According to the [Global Context Preview], Vince Phillips held the IBF junior welterweight title.

The International Boxing Federation (IBF) is one of four major organizations recognized by the International Boxing Hall of Fame (IBHOF).

Therefore, Vince Phillips held a junior welterweight title by an organization recognized by the larger International Boxing Hall of Fame (IBHOF).

FINAL ANSWER: IBHOF
